metadata.title: GEOMETRY-DERIVED STREET-FACE GROUND TRUTH
metadata.derivation_rule: Street-face may only be derived if independent physical geometry reaches GEOM_4 or GEOM_5. Zero face inference permitted from parity, door numbers, or cadastral sequences.

derived_records.derivation_justification: Achieved GEOM_1 (subdivision/block name only). In the absence of GEOM_4+ spatial geometry or explicit corner deeds, no street face can be derived without violating the strict prohibition against parity-based inference.
